title: Standard Protocols for Generation of Monocyte-derived Cell Types
protocol: Prepare a 7.5% solution of human albumin in DPBS without Ca²⁺ or Mg²⁺ in a 15 ml Falcon tube.
Remove vial of 25 µg rhM-CSF from -20°C storage and allow to equilibrate to RT for 5 min.
Transfer 2.5 ml DPBS without Ca²⁺ or Mg²⁺ into the rhM-CSF vial in fractions to dissolve and wash out all protein from the vial.
Transfer 2.5 ml rhM-CSF solution into a 50 ml Falcon tube.
Add 38 µl of human albumin solution to the 50 ml Falcon tube containing rhM-CSF solution. Mix gently.
Make 125 µl aliquots in Eppendorf cups (for 50 ml medium).
Store at -20°C for up to 8 weeks.
Prepare a 7.5% solution of human albumin in DPBS without Ca²⁺ or Mg²⁺ in a 15 ml Falcon tube.
Remove vial of 100 µg rhIFN-γ from -20°C storage and allow to equilibrate to RT for 5 min.
Transfer 3.8 ml DPBS without Ca²⁺ or Mg²⁺ into the rhIFN-γ vial in fractions to dissolve and wash out all protein from the vial.
Transfer 3.8 ml rhIFN-γ solution into a 50 ml Falcon tube.
Add 200 µl of human albumin solution to the 50 ml Falcon tube containing rhIFN-γ solution. Mix gently.
Make 100 µl aliquots in Eppendorf cups (for 50 ml medium).
Store at -20°C for up to 8 weeks.
Thaw a 100 ml aliquot of serum at 4°C overnight.
Pre-heat waterbath to 56°C.
Submerge serum bottle in 56°C waterbath for 30 min.
Transfer serum bottle to ice. Leave for 30 mins to cool.
Transfer to laminar flow hood (LFH) and decontaminate.
Make 5, 10 or 20 ml aliquots of serum in Falcon tubes.
Store aliquots at -20°C for up to 4 weeks.
In LFH, transfer 90 ml DPBS without Ca²⁺ or Mg²⁺ into a 250 ml Stericup device using a serological pipette.
Transfer 10 ml CPDA to Stericup.
Transfer 2.5 ml 20% human serum albumin to Stericup.
Filter mixture.
Store filtered MACS buffer at 4°C.
Assemble medium components in a 250 ml Stericup device in LFH.
Transfer 88 ml RPMI-1640 without phenol red (PR) into Stericup using serological pipette.
Transfer 1 ml of 200 mM GlutaMax into Stericup using serological pipette.
Transfer 1 ml 100 X Pen-Strep into Stericup using serological pipette.
Transfer 10 ml heat-inactivated human AB serum (HABS) into Stericup using serological pipette.
Transfer 250 μl recombinant human macrophage colony-stimulating factor (rhM-CSF) into Stericup using pipette.
Filter medium mixture.
Medium must be used fresh.
Assemble medium components in a 250 ml Stericup device in LFH.
Transfer 88 ml RPMI-1640 without PR into Stericup using a serological pipette.
Transfer 1 ml of 200 mM GlutaMax into Stericup using a serological pipette.
Transfer 1 ml of 100 X Pen-Strep into Stericup using a serological pipette.
Transfer 10 ml heat-inactivated FBS into Stericup using a serological pipette.
Transfer 250 µl rhM-CSF into Stericup using a pipette.
Filter the medium mixture.
Decontaminate the outside of LRS chamber using an alcohol wipe and transfer to LFH.
Hold the LRS chamber with the conical point downwards.
Clamp the lower tube with sterile surgical forceps.
Cut the lower tube with sterile scissors below the clamp.
Cut the upper tube using sterile scissors.
Hold the LRS chamber over an open 50 ml Falcon tube and remove the clamp.
Allow the contents of the LRS chamber to run into the Falcon tube.
Perform automated cell count including differential count for monocytes.
Perform flow cytometry analyses such as CD14+ monocytes.
Dilute contents of LRS chamber 1:1 in sterile DBPS without Ca²⁺ or Mg²⁺ at RT.
Transfer 20 ml Ficoll solution at RT into a 50 ml Falcon tube.
Gently overlay diluted apheresate onto Ficoll using a serological pipette.
Place the layered columns into a swing-bucket centrifuge.
Centrifuge at RT for 25 min at 850 g with low acceleration and no brake.
Remove tubes from centrifuge. Decontaminate with alcohol wipes. Transfer to LFH.
Recover mononuclear cells from interface using a 10 ml serological pipette.
Transfer mononuclear cells to a 50 ml Falcon tube.
Resuspend cells in 50 ml DBPS without Ca²⁺ or Mg²⁺ at RT.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 550 g for 10 mins at RT.
Aspirate supernatant using a 50 ml serological pipette.
Resuspend cells in 50 ml DBPS without Ca²⁺ or Mg²⁺ at RT.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 300 g for 10 mins at RT.
Aspirate supernatant using a 50 ml serological pipette.
Resuspend cell pellet in 10 ml DPBS without Ca²⁺ or Mg²⁺ at RT.
Perform total and viable cell count using the Trypan Blue method.
Transfer required volume of cell suspension to a 50 ml Falcon tube.
Transfer cells to a 50 ml Falcon.
Pellet cells at 300 g for 6 minutes.
Resuspend cells in MACS buffer at 80 μl per 10^7 total cells.
Add 20 μl CD14 Microbeads per 10^7 total cells and mix by gentle inversion.
Incubate for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Add 15 ml MACS buffer to the sample and gently mix.
Centrifuge for 6 minutes at 300 g.
Place an LS column into a magnet.
Wash the column with 3 ml MACS buffer.
Aspirate supernatant using a serological pipette.
Resuspend cells in 1 ml MACS buffer.
Pass cell suspension through a pre-separation filter on the column.
Wash the column with 3 ml MACS buffer three times.
Remove the column from the magnet and apply 5 ml MACS buffer.
Insert the column plunger to eject column contents into a 50 ml Falcon.
Take aliquots of cells for Trypan Blue count and CD14 analysis by flow cytometry.
Take the required volume of CD14 monocyte suspension into a 50 ml Falcon.
Seed monocytes at 1 x 10^6 monocytes/well in a 6-well plate.
Centrifuge the monocyte suspension at 300 g for 10 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant using a serological pipette.
Resuspend cell pellet in Mreg medium at 1 x 10^6 cells/3 ml.
Transfer monocyte suspension into well plates: 3 ml cell suspension/well.
Place the plates into a 37°C 5% CO2 incubator on horizontal shelves.
Remove culture plates from incubator.
Transfer to LFH.
Thaw aliquots of rhIFN-γ as required.
Dilute 1000x rhIFN-γ solution by 1:5 in DPBS.
Apply IFN-γ to cultures at a concentration of 25 ng/ml (i.e., add 15 μl into 3 ml well).
Gently mix by swirling.
Replace plates into incubator and incubate for an additional 18 to 24 hours.
Remove culture plates or flask from incubator.

Inspect culture plates or flasks using an inverted microscope. Assess morphology and density: Cells should be mostly adherent with a spreading morphology; spiky cells forming clusters in suspension indicate poor-quality cultures.
Transfer to LFH.
Discard medium.
Wash with DPBS (1 ml/well or 5 ml/flask).
Gently scrape with a soft cell scrapper.
Transfer cell solution into a Falcon tube.
Centrifuge for 6 min at 300 g.
Aspirate supernatant. Resuspend cells in DPBS.
Count cells by Trypan Blue method.
Assess cell phenotype by flow cytometry.
Prepare DC medium with RPMI 1640 containing Pen-Strep, GlutaMAX, 5% HABS, 100 ng/ml rhGM-CSF, and 100 ng/ml rhIL-4.
Resuspend the required number of CD14+ monocytes in DC medium at a concentration of 1 x 10^6 cells/3 ml.
Seed monocytes at 1 x 10^6 monocytes/well in a 6-well plate.
Place plates into a 37°C 5% CO2 incubator on horizontal shelves.
On day 5, harvest immature mo-DC by pipetting.
Transfer harvested cells into a Falcon tube and centrifuge for 6 min at 300 g.
Resuspend the cell pellet in X-VIVO 10 medium containing 2 mM GlutaMAX and 100 ng/ml rhGM-CSF.
Replate immature DCs in 6-well plates at 1 x 10^6 cells/well.
For maturation, add 50 ng/ml rhTNF-α and culture for 2 more days.
Harvest the cells by pipetting.
Wash wells with PBS.
Transfer cell solution into a Falcon tube.
Centrifuge for 6 min at 300 g.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend cells in DPBS.
Count cells using the Trypan Blue method.
Assess cell phenotype by flow cytometry.
Isolate CD14+ monocytes as described in Section 2 and 3.1.
Resuspend necessary amount of monocytes in FBS-containing medium at a concentration of 1 x 10^6 cells/3 ml.
Seed 1 x 10^6 monocytes/well in a 6-well plate.
On day 6, stimulate for 18-24 hours as follows: Resting Mφ with no stimulation, IFN-γ-Mφ with 25 ng/mL rhIFN-γ, and IFN-γ+LPS Mφ with 25 ng/mL rhIFN-γ + 100 ng/ml LPS.
Inspect culture plates using an inverted microscope on day 7.
Harvest cells by pipetting.
Add 1 ml DPBS per well.
Gently scrape with a soft cell scraper to harvest adherent cells.
Transfer cell solution into a Falcon tube.
Centrifuge for 6 min at 300 g.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend cells in DPBS.
Count cells by Trypan Blue method.
Assess cell phenotype by flow cytometry.
